heroSummary: Federal Way Public Schools begins the 2027–28 school year on Wednesday, September 1. Kindergarten Connection conferences and half days run through September 9. Friday early releases begin September 17, and the scheduled last day is Thursday, June 15, with early dismissal.
calendarNotes: FWPS again separates recurring Friday early releases from two special early-dismissal dates. Kindergarten begins with Connection conferences and half days. Scholar-Led Conferences close school in November and March. January 3 is a two-hour late start after Winter Break. Seniors finish June 8. February 22, May 26, June 16, and June 20 are no-school dates unless activated as snow make-up days. Juneteenth falls between the two June make-up windows, so the end-of-year sequence should be checked before summer plans are finalized.

customSections.content: FWPS schedules 29 Friday early releases, along with a two-hour late start and two separate early-dismissal dates. These schedules use different timing, so families should check the correct schedule when planning pickup or transportation.

customSections.label: Four Snow Make-Up Dates, Including Two After the Last Day
customSections.content: February 22 and May 26 are conditional make-up dates inside the school year. June 16 and June 20 sit after the scheduled June 15 last day, with the Juneteenth holiday on June 19 between them. None becomes a school day unless FWPS announces it.

whatsNew.title: What’s Different in the 2027–28 FWPS Calendar?
content: The school year starts September 1, one day earlier than in 2026–27.
Spring Break moves from April 5–9 in 2026–27 to April 3–7 in 2027–28.
The scheduled last day moves from June 17 to June 15. June 16 and June 20 remain available as conditional snow make-up dates.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Federal Way Public Schools start in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The official FWPS calendar lists Wednesday, September 1, 2027, as the first day. Kindergarten Connection conferences and half days run September 1–9.

calendarFaqs.q: When is FWPS Winter Break in 2027–28?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs December 20–31, 2027. School resumes Monday, January 3, 2028, with a two-hour late start.

calendarFaqs.q: When is FWPS Spring Break in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs April 3–7, 2028. Scholar-Led Conferences are separate no-school days on March 30–31 before the weekend leading into break.

calendarFaqs.q: Does FWPS have early release every Friday in 2027–28?
calendarFaqs.a: No. FWPS schedules 29 selected Friday early releases in 2027–28, beginning September 17. Schools dismiss early only on the dates listed in the guide above.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of FWPS in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: The scheduled last day is Thursday, June 15, 2028, with early dismissal. June 16 and June 20 are no-school days unless activated for snow make-up.

calendarFaqs.q: Does the 2027–28 FWPS calendar have translated PDFs?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. FWPS publishes official 2027–28 calendars in Dari, Korean, Pashto, Russian, Somali, Spanish, and Ukrainian as well as English.
